target_customer: Teams and startups that manage projects and increasingly work with AI agents
problem: Project management tools add overhead; Dart uses AI to create tasks, plans and reports from chat and lets agents do the work.

founders.name: Milad Malek
founders.background_notes: YC page: led Smart Cities ventures at Plug and Play.

founders.name: Zack Swafford
founders.background_notes: YC page: built Plenty's full stack, data pipelines and ML and CV models, then managed dozens of staff.

competitors.name: Height
competitors.what: project management tool with an autonomous layer, New York
competitors.funding_then: 14 million dollar Series A at 2021 public launch (single directory)

technical_complexity.rationale: A project management product with LLM chat and agent integrations is standard product engineering with model work, and the 2024 launch depended on third party models.

defensibility.rationale: Teams storing work in Dart face some switching cost, but Asana, ClickUp, Monday and Linear all added AI and no source shows a data or network moat.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: The YC launch post says other PM tools add AI features; customer testimonials on the site name Asana, ClickUp and Monday as tools users came from. No acquisition found.

market_need_then: Dart claims to save users seven hours per week on PM overhead in its earlier YC launch; demand evidence in 2022 is not independently sourced.

branding.domain_note: Uses itsdart.com and dartai.com, neither an exact dart.com match.

identity.logo: brand guidelines page exists at dartai.com/brand, contents not seen
identity.voice_and_tone: Cursor for project management positioning on the YC launch

branding.brand_signature: Positioning line: Cursor for project management
branding.community_and_virality: Several Product Hunt launches and an AppSumo listing; no evidence of meme or merch.

brand_strength.rationale: A generic word used by other products, with its own domain prefix; a clear positioning line and Product Hunt activity help a little.

pivots.to: Project management with AI chat and agents for the agent era
pivots.why: Product expansion announced October 2025; Product Hunt date shows September 2025.

outcome_analysis: Dart launched publicly in March 2024 after a 500K pre seed in 2022 and has added AI chat and agents. The site claims over 100,000 teams, which is unverified. No acquisition, layoffs or later rounds were found. It competes in a crowded category with incumbents adding AI, so the outcome is open and modest in evidence.
notes: The 500K pre seed comes from the VCBacked aggregator only (one source) and AppSumo calls the stage Seed; treat as unverified. Competitors: Linear, Motion and Asana were around in 2022, but only Height has a dated source in the searches. Directory says HQ Covina, YC says San Francisco. The 100,000 team claim is from the company site.
